headline: Tidy Bot grows a second arm
lede: The chores bot now works the house with both hands: grab two at once, and the order you picked them up is the order they come off. Carrying a full tray slows the walk — the trade-off a butler robot would make.

notes.text: Two-slot carry shipped to TIDY BOT (#2266): A fills an empty arm, a third grab refuses with a named ARMS FULL, and one press releases exactly one item — front arm first, tray after. A wrong item can never hide behind the good one.

The tray is real physics: carrying two drags the legs at 82% speed and tilts with every step, and the level only closes when both arms are empty. A new order mutant (flip the queue) turns exactly the two FIFO gates red — proof the rule is load-bearing.

The autopilot learned table manners too: it double-loads only litter bound for the same container, so the attract demo and the win-proof both show off the tray — roughly 800 two-carry ticks per seed, wrong-stow-free.

Two demo titles landed tonight: slot b's FROSTBRUSH fox (#2261) gallops in /retrogames/demos/ while slot a's carry stage upgraded the arcade shelf — lanes stayed off each other's files and ports all shift.
